input.title: Needs 3x Undo action to undo a partial Font Color on a note
input.body:
## Issue I: Needs 3x Undo action to undo a partial Font Color on a note

## Step to Reproduce
1. Create new thought
2. Add a note on the thought
3. Select a word on the note
4. Apply any Font Color
5. Click Undo


## Current behavior
Nothing happens.
Needs 3 Undo action to undo a partial Font Color on a note

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aa3efded-631c-44db-9451-3228ad43080d


## Expected behavior
Font Color reverts to previous color, in this case it is note's default grey color

_Originally posted by @BayuAri in https://github.com/cybersemics/em/issues/4034#issuecomment-4468862402_
